acts.title: Boxes
acts.lighting: Warm and dim. Rain on the windows.

gate_to_next.description: The player has sorted at least ten objects and has found the dead phone on the bedside table. Finding it sets the goal text: His phone. Dead. The charger wasn't with it.

acts.title: Under Things
acts.lighting: Deeper night. The rain gets heavier.

gate_to_next.description: The phone charges in real time while the player keeps sorting, then the chime. The waiting is the point: it builds dread out of an ordinary household delay.

ends_when.description: The desk has been gone through and the bag by the door has been opened. Both are the end of a chain the thread starts, and neither can happen before it. There is no sorting quota here: what is still in the flat at this point is what the player has decided to leave, and the game holds no opinion about it.

scenes.title: Opening
scenes.summary: Black screen. Rain. Key in the lock, the specific loose-cylinder sound of a door you have opened a thousand times.
steps: Key in the lock. The loose cylinder.
First interactables: the light switch, lena_note, rako_note.

scenes.title: The chime
scenes.summary: The phone has been charging for a few real minutes while the player keeps sorting. The chime is quiet and lands mid-task, wherever the player happens to be standing.
scenes.design_note: Everything about the sound design should make the player stop on their own. No forced camera, no objective marker, no interruption of whatever they were doing. If they keep sorting for another ten minutes, that is allowed.

scenes.title: The desk scene, the no-note beat
scenes.summary: After the thread is read, the desk activates. Interaction becomes rapid: drawers open in sequence, papers lift, and the monologue shortens to fragments. The drawer sounds get faster, then stop. Long silence on the last empty drawer.

blocks.text: (Drawers open in sequence. Papers lift. The sounds get faster.)
(The sounds stop. Long silence on the last empty drawer.)
Most people don't leave one. You knew that. You looked anyway.
(Nothing else. No music sting. The rain continues.)

scenes.design_note: Hard Rule 3. This absence is the scene. It must never be fixed and no note may ever be added, not as content and not as cut content. The single line is the entire payoff and nothing may be appended to it.

scenes.title: Ending sequence
scenes.summary: The keep box seals, the player takes one thing, the voicemail plays, and the flat is left the way it was always going to be left.
steps: The SHIP TO LENA box seals. Tape sound, printed label with her address.
Prompt: Take one thing. The player picks any single object out of the keep box. No commentary on the choice, ever. It slides into your bag beside the eight envelopes.
Your own phone buzzes softly. Not a call. You open Saved voicemails: one entry, two years old.
Key in the bowl. String lights off, unless the player left them on, in which case they stay on and are visible from the street below in the final exterior shot.
Door. Stairwell. Grey-gold morning. The rain has stopped.
Final card in small type, then the resources screen.
scenes.design_note: The steps are the order of the sequence. The words are in two scenes rather than one because they are two screens in two registers: the voicemail is him, and the final card is the game speaking to the player.

scenes.title: Saved voicemails, one entry
scenes.summary: The player's own phone, over a black screen. Not a call. The last time the player hears him, and it is about nothing at all, which is the point.

blocks.text: okay so, update... Beni says if we win tonight he's naming the sauce after us...
that's it, that's the whole message. bring cash. see you Wednesday.

scenes.design_note: Two years old, and about a football result and where to meet. Nothing in it is a sign of anything, and nothing in it may be made into one. Hard Rule 5: he was funny, and this is where that is load-bearing.

scenes.title: The final card
scenes.summary: Small type, over the exterior. One sentence, and then the support resources.

blocks.text: If you're carrying something like this, you don't have to sort it alone.

scenes.design_note: The one place the game addresses the player rather than the flat. Section 11: it leads to the resources screen and does not ask anything of them first.

goals.text: Pack what you can. The lease ends Sunday.
His phone. Dead. The charger wasn't with it.
The desk. You have been leaving it until later all night.
There is nothing else to look for. Finish up.
